```{r}
str_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% c("6"))
grp_list <- str_sub@meta.data %>% with(split(rownames(.), sample.name))
data <- GetAssayData(str_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "data")

sub_cond_var <- lapply(grp_list, function(grp){
  feat_var <- data[, grp] %>% apply(1, var)
  }) %>% 
  do.call(cbind, .)

sub_cond_mean <- lapply(grp_list, function(grp){
  feat_var <- data[, grp] %>% apply(1, mean)
  }) %>% 
  do.call(cbind, .)

sub_cond_norm <- sub_cond_var/sub_cond_mean

```


```{r}
gene_data <- GetAssayData(str_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "data")["Cd14",] %>% sort
cell_sample <- str_sub@meta.data %>% with(set_names(sample.name, rownames(.)))

data.frame(r = 1:length(gene_data),
           expr = gene_data,grp = cell_sample[names(gene_data)])%>%
  ggplot(aes(r, color = grp))+
  geom_density()

data.frame(r = 1:length(gene_data),
           expr = gene_data,
           grp = cell_sample[names(gene_data)])%>% 
  ggplot(aes(r, fill = grp))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_wrap(~grp,ncol = 1)

data.frame(r = 1:length(gene_data),
           expr = gene_data,
           grp = cell_sample[names(gene_data)])%>%
    filter(gene_data>0) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(r, fill = grp))+
    geom_histogram()+
    facet_wrap(~grp,ncol = 1)

data.frame(r = 1:length(gene_data),
           expr = gene_data,grp = cell_sample[names(gene_data)])%>%
  ggplot(aes(expr, color = grp))+
  geom_density()

data.frame(r = 1:length(gene_data),
           expr = gene_data,grp = cell_sample[names(gene_data)])%>%
    ggplot(aes(grp, expr, color = grp))+
    geom_jitter()

data.frame(r = 1:length(gene_data),
           expr = gene_data,
           grp = cell_sample[names(gene_data)])%>% 
  ggplot(aes(expr, fill = grp))+

  facet_wrap(~grp,ncol = 1)

data.frame(r = 1:length(gene_data),
```

```{r}
pos     <- Embeddings(srt_sub, "pca.SCT")[, 1:10]
genes   <- c("Matn4","Cfap54","Lpl" ,"Podxl", "Col18a1", "Cd14")
data    <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(srt_sub, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")[genes, ])
res     <- Seurat::RunMoransI(data = data, pos = pos)
tibble::tibble(
  gene      = rownames(res),
  morans_i  = res$observed,
  p_value   = res$p.value,
  p_adj     = p.adjust(res$p.value, method = "BH"),
  condition = condition_label
) |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(morans_i))
```
```{r}
all_cells <- colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
sub_cells <- colnames(srt_sub)
x <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@neighbors$neighbors_pca.SCT_30@nn.idx[ all_cells %in% sub_cells, ]
data <- GetAssayData(srt_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "data")

DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,cells.highlight = all_cells[x[1,]])

gene_ng_avg <- apply(x, 1, function(ng){
  cells <- all_cells[ng]
  cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(data)]
  Matrix::rowMeans(data[,cells])
})

gene_ng_avg <- apply(x, 1, function(ng){
  cells <- all_cells[ng]
  cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(data)]
  Matrix::rowMeans(data[,cells])
})
colnames(gene_ng_avg) <- all_cells[ all_cells %in% sub_cells]

ng_size <- apply(x, 1, function(ng){
    cells <- all_cells[ng]
    sum(cells %in% colnames(data))
})

gene_rnd_avg <- apply(x, 1, function(ng){
  cells <- all_cells[ng]
  cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(data)]
  s <- sample(sub_cells, length(cells))
  Matrix::rowMeans(data[,s])
})

feat <- "Cd14"
enframe(gene_ng_avg[feat,],name = "cell_id") %>% 
  full_join(srt_sub@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id")) %>% 
  bind_rows(data.frame(sample.name = "random",value = gene_rnd_avg[feat,] )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(sample.name, value))+
  geom_boxplot()


```
```{r}
gene_rnd_avg <- apply(x, 1, function(ng){
  cells <- all_cells[ng]
  cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(data)]
  s <- sample(sub_cells, length(cells))
  Matrix::rowMeans(data[,s])
})
gene_grp_avg <- apply(x, 1, function(ng){
  cells <- all_cells[ng]
  cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(data)]
  s <- sample(sub_cells, length(cells))
  mean(cell_sample[s] == "HSC_WT_CD41+")
})

feat <- "Cd14"
enframe(gene_ng_avg[feat,],name = "cell_id") %>% 
    mutate(wt_prop = gene_grp_avg) %>%
  ggplot(aes(wt_prop, value))+
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
srt_sub   <-FindVariableFeatures(srt_sub,nfeatures = 100)
x <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@neighbors$neighbors_pca.SCT_30@nn.idx[ all_cells %in% sub_cells, ]
data <- GetAssayData(str_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "data")

column_ha = ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(sample.name = srt_sub$sample.name,
                                              col = list(sample.name = setNames( c( "red", "green","blue"),unique(srt_sub$sample.name))))

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(data[VariableFeatures(srt_sub),] %>% as.matrix(),
                        show_column_names = FALSE,
                        top_annotation = column_ha)
```
